content:
Hi everyone! I’m Steve. My background and interests are mostly in mathematics and mathematical physics, and lately I’ve been spending quite a bit of time with Lean 4.

One project I’m working on is a formalization of Boolean-valued analysis. At the moment I’m developing the foundations needed for Boolean-valued models of set theory in Lean, with the longer-term goal of formalizing some of the machinery of Boolean-valued analysis and seeing how far it can be pushed toward applications in functional analysis and operator theory.

Alongside that, I’ve been translating Kusraev and Kutateladze’s Introduction to Boolean-Valued Analysis, which has been a useful guide for figuring out what the formalization will eventually need.

I’m still learning a great deal about Lean and mathlib as I go, so I’m looking forward to learning from everyone here and hopefully contributing something useful along the way.
